main_body: A single round leaf-mass (bush canopy) with three small brown twig patches. It has no trunk and no separate front face, and the whole sprite reads as a foliage clump seen from above.
top_band: none. The column scan shows only alternating light and dark green leaf clumps (L 40-174) from top to bottom, with no distinct top surface, front-edge step or front face.
evidence: The silhouette is a round, spiky blob filled uniformly with leaf clumps. No lighter horizontal top band sits above a vertical front face, and the lower rows are the same green clump pattern as the upper ones. It reads as a flat top-down foliage slab (plan view) with no volume or south face, unlike the reference trees, which have a canopy above a trunk. It does not meet the 3/4 contract, so it fails.

style.evidence: The piece has about 5 green steps, from a pale yellow-green highlight to a deep teal-green. Leaf clumps are shaded individually, and the 5x5 flat-fill coverage is 0%. Median distinct colours per tile is 101, against 108 and 109 for the references, so it is about equal. Total distinct colours (203) is lower only because the sprite is smaller. The dark edge pixels are tinted green (0% neutral), so the outline is a dark material tone and not a sticker line. It would sit acceptably next to the references.
